Use-case & requirements summary:
- Workloads: support chat (low-latency, SLA 150ms p95), daily telemetry summarization (batch, high throughput), embeddings for doc-search and reranking.
- Latency/throughput targets: p95 <= 150ms for chat; throughput up to 20 req/s during peak for summarization jobs.
- Model preferences: open models preferred; willingness to pin to vetted quantized variants.
- Routing/fallback: require fallback to smaller models during capacity spikes; cost-aware routing a plus.
- Security: strict SSO/SAML, KMS + HSM integration, audit logging, 3-year retention policy for some records, data residency in NA.

- Functional: POC met quality bar for summarization and support flows. Product team happy with hallucination reduction after prompt-engineering.
- Ops: Redwood dedicated cluster performed well; SE set up KV cache config that dropped token costs.
- Security: Outstanding items: formal SOC2 attestation copy, pen-test summary, final KMS proof-of-concept in their staging environment. These were escalated (SEC-2218).

- Primary blocker is a company-wide hiring/spend freeze declared by finance — no resources for new vendor commitments this quarter.
- Secondary: loss of momentum internally after Product VP reprioritized roadmap to regulatory reporting features. No executive champion remains to push purchase.
- Procurement is not saying "no" — they are deferring decisions until budgets reopen; timeline uncertain.
